title: 1960 AHSME Problem 3
statement: Applied to a bill for \(\$10{,}000\) the difference between a discount of \(40\%\) and two successive discounts of \(36\%\) and \(4\%,\) expressed in dollars, is:

solutions.text:
A \(40\%\) discount is \(\$4000.\) The successive discounts total \[ 3600+0.04(6400)=3856. \] Their difference is \(4000-3856=144\) dollars.

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Successive discounts are applied one after the other, not added
Compare \(40\%\) of the bill with \(36\%\) plus \(4\%\) of the remaining \(64\%\)
